Fait d'un conteneur une liste triable — un brouillon qui se réordonne pendant le glissement et qui est réécrit au dépôt.
Fait d'un conteneur un arbre triable, rendu à plat avec des profondeurs — imbrication en glissant de côté ou en survolant un nœud.

import { DnDProvider } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import TodoList from './TodoList.vue';
</script>

<template>
  <DnDProvider>
    <TodoList />
  </DnDProvider>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableList } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import TodoRow from './TodoRow.vue';

const todos = ref([
  { id: 'milk', text: 'Buy oat milk', done: true },
  { id: 'call', text: 'Call the dentist', done: false },
  { id: 'plants', text: 'Water the plants', done: false },
  { id: 'book', text: 'Return the library book', done: false },
  { id: 'run', text: 'Go for a run', done: false },
]);
const listRef = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');
const { items } = makeSortableList(listRef, { items: todos });
const left = computed(() => todos.value.filter((todo) => !todo.done).length);
const toggle = (id: string) => {
  const todo = todos.value.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
  if (todo) todo.done = !todo.done;
};
</script>

<template>
  <div class="card">
    <header>
      <strong>Today</strong>
      <span>{{ left }} left</span>
    </header>
    <ul ref="list" class="list">
      <TodoRow v-for="todo in items" :key="todo.id" :todo="todo" @toggle="toggle(todo.id)" />
    </ul>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.card {
  width: min(380px, 100%);
  padding: 16px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 10%, transparent);

.list {
  display: flex;

  list-style: none;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableItem } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';

const props = defineProps<{ todo: { id: string; text: string; done: boolean } }>();
defineEmits<{ toggle: [] }>();
const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');
const grip = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('grip');

// Only the grip drags, so the checkbox and the text stay usable. `index` is the row's place
// in the draft: it changes while you drag.
const { index, isPlaceholder } = makeSortableItem(el, { item: () => props.todo, handle: grip });
</script>

<template>
  <li ref="el" class="row" :class="{ done: todo.done, slot: isPlaceholder }">
    <button ref="grip" type="button" class="grip" :aria-label="`Move “${todo.text}”`">⋮⋮</button>
    <input type="checkbox" :checked="todo.done" :aria-label="todo.text" @change="$emit('toggle')" />
    <span class="text">{{ todo.text }}</span>
    <span class="index">{{ index + 1 }}</span>
  </li>
</template>

<style scoped>
